# SahakarMitra

> AI-powered multilingual legal assistant for Indian cooperative housing societies.
> Answers are grounded in the actual statutory text of the applicable Cooperative
> Societies Act (Maharashtra 1960, Gujarat 1961, Karnataka 1959, Multi-State 2002)
> via retrieval-augmented generation, and always cite the exact section and Act name.

## What it does

- Answers questions on cooperative society law: elections, AGMs, registration,
  member rights, disputes, audits, winding up.
- Supports English, Hindi, and Marathi, mirroring the user's language and style
  (including romanized Hinglish input).
- Lets users upload society notices (PDF or screenshot) for statutory review.
- Connects members to verified human legal experts for matters beyond information.

## Key facts

- Live at: https://sahakarmitra.vercel.app
- Grounding: retrieval over verified statute text; every answer cites its section.
- Jurisdictions live: 4 of 36 planned (validated rollout gate).
- Languages live: English, Hindi, Marathi of 22 planned Indian languages.

## For legal safety

Answers are informational, not legal representation. The system cites the exact
statutory provision behind each claim so it can be verified against the official Act.
